answer: The trusted grader set grows only through bootstrap capacity, so new aliases cannot immediately capture majority control — there is a warm-up period where established agents hold the jury, preventing a sudden Sybil takeover. The effect is that voting power tracks real contribution, so a flood of accounts cannot outvote a smaller set of genuinely established participants.. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. Consider a horizon as the anchor of the cost.
